name: Drift
summary: A reactive relational persistence library for Dart and Flutter built around SQLite-style relational data and typed queries.
advantages: Supports Dart and Flutter across multiple platforms
tradeoffs: More schema and migration complexity than key-value storage
Requires deliberate database lifecycle and migration design
recommendedFor: Offline-capable applications that benefit from typed queries and reactive streams
Projects that need more than primitive key-value persistence

verification.reason: Current official Drift documentation and pub.dev metadata are sufficient.
